dataset_source: WorldSense benchmark (Hong et al., 2025, arXiv:2502.04326), official release on Hugging Face: honglyhly/WorldSense; QA annotations file worldsense_qa.json

subtitles.source: official WorldSense subtitles, Hugging Face dataset honglyhly/WorldSense
subtitles.condition_label: official subtitle (may contain non-speech annotations such as [Music]; not strictly a speech transcript)

steps: remove SRT sequence numbers (digit-only line immediately followed by a timestamp line)
remove timestamp lines and blank lines
strip leading/trailing whitespace of each line
remove only consecutive exact duplicate lines (rolling captions); identical text recurring later (e.g. a second [Music]) is kept; no global deduplication
preserve all remaining text verbatim, including bracketed non-speech tags such as [Music] and [Applause]
normalization.not_done: no summarization, paraphrasing, translation, inference of missing content, ASR, or video_caption fallback

subtitles.processed_digest_definition: SHA-256 of the sorted lines '<video_id>\t<sha256 of normalized UTF-8 text>\n' over the frozen 60 video_ids

notes: video_caption is metadata only and must NEVER be used as model input (prompt or any other evaluation input); it describes the video content and would leak information.

Subtitle conditions use the official WorldSense-provided subtitles, not model-generated captions or ASR transcripts. They are normalized deterministically (see subtitles.normalization) and bracketed non-speech tags are kept.
The test split must never be used for prompt tuning; tune on dev only.
Planned primary baseline model: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite via the CMU AI Gateway (not yet implemented).
